F01 Loop and built-in tools

Loop shape

F01.loop-shape How a turn runs: plan, tool call, result, stop.

● supported

Value: The core interprets tool use requests from the Gemini model and returns tool execution results to the model for further processing. A `continue` field set to `false` kills the entire agent loop immediately. Automatic detection and prevention of infinite loops can be disabled via a setting.

Evidence:

  • E-gemini-cli-00370

    - Interpreting tool use requests from the Gemini model.

    Source: https://geminicli.com/llms.txt; retrieved 2026-10-04; version not recorded; tier E1

    - Returning tool execution results to the Gemini model for further processing.

Turn and step limits

F01.turn-limits Caps on turns, steps or tokens per run, and stop conditions.

● supported ! unverified [unverified: no verified evidence record; settles by A tester pass of this supported cell against its cited quotes. It was outside the 30% verification sample.]

Value: `model.maxSessionTurns` caps the user/model/tool turns kept in a session (-1 means unlimited). A subagent's `max_turns` field caps conversation turns before it must return (defaults to 30). `maxActionsPerTask` caps tool calls per task; the agent is terminated when the limit is reached. Exit code 53 means the session turn maximum was reached (non-interactive mode only).

● supported ! unverified [unverified: no verified evidence record; settles by A tester pass of this supported cell against its cited quotes. It was outside the 30% verification sample.]

Automatic compaction

F02.auto-compaction When and how history is summarized without a command.

● supported ! unverified [unverified: no verified evidence record; settles by A tester pass of this supported cell against its cited quotes. It was outside the 30% verification sample.]

Value: The core automatically compresses the conversation history before sending it to the model. The fraction of context usage at which compression triggers is set by `model.compressionThreshold` (example values 0.2, 0.3; listed value 0.5). A PreCompress hook fires before the CLI summarizes history to save tokens.

Persistent memory

F02.persistent-memory Memory that survives sessions: files, notes or an auto-memory store.

● supported

Value: Gemini CLI persists durable facts, user preferences, and project details; the agent edits the appropriate memory Markdown file when told to remember a fact. Auto Memory is an experimental feature that mines past sessions; extracted patches are written as `.patch` files held for review in /memory inbox, and nothing is applied until you approve it.

Auto-loaded files

● supported

Value: Context files use the default name `GEMINI.md`, and a setting names the context file or files to load into memory. F04 Permission engine

Approval modes

F04.approval-modes Named levels of how much the agent may do without asking.

● supported

Value: The --approval-mode flag sets approval for tool execution, with choices default, auto_edit, yolo and plan. 'default' prompts for approval, 'auto_edit' auto-approves edit tools, 'plan' is read-only. Shift+Tab cycles default (prompt), auto_edit (auto-approve edits) and plan (read-only); plan is skipped when the agent is busy.

Auto-accept and autonomous modes

F19.autonomy-mode Modes that act without per-step approval.

◐ partial

Value: --approval-mode=yolo auto-approves all actions (the --yolo flag is deprecated). auto_edit auto-approves edit tools. Ctrl+Y toggles YOLO (auto-approval) mode for tool calls. autoEdit is optimized for automated code editing.
